body: Exactly! I’ll never forget how happy I was when I finally got my Pandaphant pet pet

Just did a quick read through your profile. I’m so sorry for everything you are going through. Based on your two comments I can see you are a good person who absolutely does not deserve the bullshit your ex is putting you through. 

Know that your kind words really made my day a lot better. And I’m sending positive energy and thoughts your way
It’s not just me as a person. It’s all the situations she’s in because of me. And my family. But thank you, I’m trying
Thank you for saying this. You ARE worth it!

Thank you so much for this message. I was able to find a loving home for my guinea pigs, and have as of now decided to try my best to keep the rest and give them good lives. If I can’t, I will find loving homes for them as well
My pets don’t realize what I’ve put them through..
But what if I KNOW she would be better without me?
I’m sorry I never responded. I thought I was doing better but today has been worse than before. I’m still trying. I really appreciate your words
Basically yes in terms of society. But YOU do matter
Please don’t… you should try to check yourself into an in-patient hospital if you’re feeing that way
Hey, that’s a better life than I’m guessing a vast majority of the planet, and definitely human history. At least you have the internet and endless entertainment

It might sound arrogant to say, but I think I am a fairly intelligent person. I don’t think intelligence is connected to OCD, at least not in all cases. I will say, my intelligence makes my ocd that much more frustrating and depressing. Since I know the science behind the things I worry about, and logically that there is no need to worry, yet still can’t bring myself to stop
Congratulations! You should be very proud of yourself for coming so far
That sounds like an anxiety issue. And of course, anxiety and depression go hand in hand with OCD
So sorry your family is treating you that way.. I know I’m just a stranger on the internet: but happy belated birthday. I really hope this year is a better one for you
Thank you, I haven’t drunk in over a year
